newsitem.title: USA: Maxco sees Q4 boost from acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Maxco sees Q4 boost from acquisition.

text.p: Maxco Inc on Friday said its acquisition of the assets of Atmosphere Annealing Inc would have a positive impact on the company's pretax earnings and revenue in the fourth quarter ending March 31.
The company said it bought Atmosphere Annealing in Lansing, Mich., for cash, the assumption of certain obligations and subordinated notes. It did no reveal the financial terms of the transaction.
Atmosphere Annealing provides metal heat-treating services to Midwestern industrial users.
Maxco Chairman Max Coon continues to own 25 percent of the capital stock of Atmosphere Annealing, which had sales of about $27 million in the year ended December 31.
Coon also owns about 25 percent of Maxco's outstanding common shares.

The acquisition provides Maxco with a base business with total annual sales of about $100 million in the service and wholesale distribution areas. It also provides investments in real estate and a 20 percent share in Medar Inc.
